target.statement: RSIF achieves AP = 0.17 on the glass dataset, outperforming IF (0.13), LOF (0.15), HBOS (0.15), ECOD (0.12), and SF (0.14).

compute.basis: The glass dataset is tiny (214x7) and RSIF is a tree ensemble with default 100 trees and subsample 256; the official repository provides code and data, so a single run of 10 trials should take under a minute on CPU.
